ambiguities_or_notes: Every source block (20) has a matching target block, with page markers, numbering, quotation structure, and italics preserved.

Website Circle of Reading paragraphs served as the first draft; each was re-read against the Russian and revised where it drifted (omissions, additions, generic he/his, terminology, attribution form).

«Осуждать» (osuzhdat', 'condemn') is 'condemn' throughout, where the website draft sometimes had 'judge'; «судить» (sudit') in the Gospel passage is 'judge'. Matthew 7:1–5 is translated from Tolstoy's Russian wording («сучок», suchok, 'twig'; «бревно», brevno, 'log'), not from an English Bible, and the proverb's «бог два простит» ('God will forgive two') is kept without the draft's added 'sins'.
